summary: EyePoint filed a routine 8-K on 2026-09-10 attaching an updated investor presentation (Exhibit 99.1) covering expanded Phase 3 LUGANO analyses of DURAVYU for wet AMD. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural event is disclosed. The filing merely states the presentation was posted to the company website under Item 8.01 Other Events with the exhibit furnished under Item 9.01. No deal terms apply; the event is a clinical-data and investor-communications update, not a special situation. Monitor clinical timelines and any future financing or partnership announcements.
